as_told.title: Cattle mutilations on the Archuleta Ranch

plain: Near Aztec, New Mexico, people say they found dead animals with parts cut away as cleanly as a surgeon would, and with no blood. A local resident says on Michels's show that it "looked like a surgeon had taken it off. No, but no blood." A rancher on the same episode says much the same and places it on the Archuleta Ranch. He says "the ears and eyes were still intact," though he says nothing about blood. Both say they saw it themselves, on an episode about a claimed crash of a craft with alien bodies near Aztec. If true, cuts that clean would point to something other than predators or ordinary tools.
